$comment: The one source of every public claim. README blocks between <!-- claims:<key> --> markers are generated from it by `node scripts/claims.mjs`, and CI checks they match. No prices here: quotes come from the Cuddler tools at runtime.
tagline: Make AI videos and images from Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, with the Cuddler membership you already have.
beta: **Beta.** The skills are new and still changing. Tell us what breaks in the issues.
credits: Renders spend credits from your own Cuddler account, at the same price as in the Cuddler app. Your agent shows the price first and waits for your OK.
limits: A render above 200 credits also needs one click on an approval link in your browser, and each connected app can spend up to 3,000 credits a day.
plans: Videos need a Cuddler plan that includes video. The setup skill tells you what your account can make.

mcp.label: Cuddler in ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants
